gloss: head slightly bowed; looking down a little

definitions.gloss: (with one's) head slightly tilted down; looking down a little
definitions.explanation: A posture or facial set in which the head is bowed somewhat — often expressing shyness, sadness, or thoughtfulness. Common as a description of demeanor in narration.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧うつむき{加減|かげん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{答|こた}えた→答える：01099_kotaeru⟧。
examples.english: She answered with her head tilted slightly down.

examples.japanese: うつむき{加減|かげん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{歩|ある}いていたら→歩く：00538_aruku⟧⟦{知|し}り{合|あ}い→知り合い：03253_shiriai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦ぶつかった→ぶつかる：02412_butsukaru⟧。
examples.english: Walking with my eyes down, I bumped into someone I knew.

examples.japanese: ⟦{叱|しか}られた→叱る：01202_shikaru⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧うつむき{加減|かげん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{聞|き}いていた→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
examples.english: The scolded child listened quietly with his head bowed.

notes:
Compound of ⟦うつむく→うつむく：07383_utsumuku⟧ (to look down, to bow one's head) + 〜⟦{加減|かげん}→加減：02602_kagen⟧ (degree; -ish). The ⟦{加減|かげん}→加減：02602_kagen⟧ suffix softens to 'a bit' or 'slightly', so the whole phrase is 'a slight downward tilt of the head'.

USAGE:
- Shyness: when meeting someone for the first time
- Sadness or shame: after being scolded, after bad news
- Thoughtfulness: while considering an answer

SIMILAR WORDS:
- 〜⟦{加減|かげん}→加減：02602_kagen⟧: -ish; somewhat — also seen in ⟦{太|ふと}り→太る：01190_futoru⟧⟦{加減|かげん}→加減：02602_kagen⟧ (a bit plump), ⟦{疲|つか}れ→疲れ：03518_tsukare⟧⟦{加減|かげん}→加減：02602_kagen⟧ (a bit tired)
- ⟦うつむく→うつむく：07383_utsumuku⟧: to bow one's head — the base verb, used when the action is more pronounced
- ⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{向|む}く→向く：02304_muku⟧: to face downward — concrete and physical, no emotional reading
